status.evidence: According to a press release from Radius, Radius acquired a majority share in Manchester-based fleet video telematics provider VUE Group on 20 December 2021.

claims.claim: The company reports hardware solutions including the VMC range of video telematics recorders (VMC2, VMC4, and VMC8) supporting 1 to 8 high-definition cameras, GPS/GLONASS receivers, 3-Axis G-Shock sensors, and the VUEtrack standalone telematics unit, according to product literature on the VUE Group Website.

The company reports that its VMC4 four-camera video telematics recorder integrates 4-channel 4G connectivity alongside GPS/GLONASS/QZSS satellite receivers to transmit positional data, speed, and 3-axis G-shock metrics to its web-based VUEhub tracking portal, as detailed in the official product specifications.

In a fleet management deployment for the UK Ministry of Defence transporter fleet announced in November 2025, the company deployed an integrated system combining onboard camera sensors with GPS tracking and mobile connectivity to feed real-time convoy tracking data directly to the VUEhub operations portal.
claims.note: direct tracking to VUEhub operations portal vs generic deployment details

claims.claim: VUE Group introduced the "Customer Activity Auditing" feature and a new "Footage Audit Log" on its VUEhub telematics platform to track platform access and manage video data for GDPR compliance, as detailed by its Data Protection Officer Steve English.

VUE Group implemented customized cybersecurity measures and GDPR compliance protocols to protect live convoy tracking and incident footage for FTX Logistics Ltd during its telematics solution deployment for the UK Ministry of Defence transporter fleet, an operation announced in November 2025.
claims.note: specific claim that VUE Group implemented customized cybersecurity measures and GDPR compliance protocols to protect live convoy tracking and incident footage for FTX Logistics Ltd

claims.claim: VUE Group deployed its VUEhub platform to manage a mixed fleet of more than 100 vehicles for Shred Station across the UK, integrating Direct Vision Standard (DVS)-compliant camera kits, sensors, and driver distraction monitoring under one platform.

A case study published by VUE Group confirms that the company deployed its centralized fleet management platform, DVS-compliant safety systems, and AI-powered driver monitoring across Shred Station's commercial fleet.

A project report published by VUE Group details that the company provided its fleet camera system health monitoring service to XPO Logistics for a trial covering 154 vehicles within its Arla Foods contract fleet.
VUE Group was acquired by global fleet and connectivity solutions provider Radius, which purchased a majority share in the company on 20 December 2021.
VUE Group provides video telematics under the Crown Commercial Service (CCS) RM6143 framework, where it has been approved as an official Lot 1 and Lot 2 public sector supplier.

VUE Group is an Aviva Specialist Partner, a formal arrangement where Aviva commercial fleet customers are offered preferential rates on the company's risk management, integrated camera, and telematics systems.

AXA UK operates a commercial lines partnership with VUE Group under the "VUE motor" program, directly marketing discounted video telematics hardware and VUEhub platform access to AXA's fleet clients to assist with claims resolution and risk management.
VUE Group's cloud management subsidiary, VUEcloud, was established in 2014 and took over CCTV video telematics and footage management for 10 NHS Ambulance Trusts in 2015, a role it continues to hold.
XPO Logistics initiated a trial of bridge safety technology for its UK road fleet in partnership with VUE Group to enhance operational efficiency.
VUE Group reports that it maintains its headquarters in Salford Quays, Manchester, UK, and operates with an in-house nationwide footprint of over 80 employees.
VUE Group provides client support through an in-house customer service and engineering department based at its Salford office, operating standard weekday office hours of 37.5 hours per week.
claims.source: VUE Group official site (Support Form, Careers, About VUE pages) and published recruitment postings (September 2026) for Customer Service Team Leader positions in Salford.
